purpose: Teach: 目録/一挙/チェンジ/扶養/誘致/下部/所在地/本編

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 資料の目録を更新しましょう
lines.style: Crisp, organized tone. Efficient pace, no hesitation. Light touch of authority — someone moving through a checklist with purpose. Straightforward eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。年末商戦で一挙に売り上げを伸ばしましょう
lines.en: Yes. Let's drive up sales with the year-end push.
lines.style: Eager agreement with practical intent. Warm, collaborative undertone. Slight lean-in on the goal. Not robotic — genuine buy-in on the strategy.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 部署の役割をチェンジしましょう
lines.style: Measured directive. Even tempo, no rush. Light clarity in the delivery — this is a plan, not a whim. Calm confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。扶養家族の異動届を整理します
lines.en: Yes. I'll organize the family status transfer forms.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Reliable tone — someone noting the task and filing it mentally. Professional warmth, no resistance. Small nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 企業誘致のための補助金を申請しましょう
lines.en: Let's apply for the subsidies for corporate recruitment.
lines.style: Clear directive with slight emphasis on the importance. Purposeful pace. The tone of someone moving to the next phase. Grounded, not pushing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。組織下部の若手の声も拾います
lines.en: Yes. I'll also make sure to hear out the junior staff.
lines.style: Thoughtful agreement that adds dimension. Slight warmth on 'hear out' — this is conscious leadership, not just task completion. Attentive, genuine.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 支店の所在地を地図に追加しましょう
lines.en: Let's add the branch locations to the map.
lines.style: Instructional but not curt. Steady rhythm. The voice of someone consolidating information. Light precision on 'add' — practical, methodical.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。提案書の本編を仕上げます
lines.en: Yes. I'll finalize the main proposal draft.
lines.style: Affirmative closing note. Quiet satisfaction — wrapping up. Slightly slower pace, like settling into the final task. Reliable finish.
